notes:
# OverCue firmware 1.0.0

- Fix play/pause briefly muting the deck's output on tracks without stems, and on the first moment of playback after stems became ready.
- Keep linked stems playing through a brief internal read error instead of restarting the stems session.
- Fix jumps into not-yet-loaded stems with Master Tempo on not waiting for the stems to load, and bound repeated Master Tempo retries so they cannot hold back playback.
- Keep mixer stem EQ working after a temporary communication failure, instead of staying off until the player restarts.
- Refuse an oversized linked two-stem copy when memory is short, instead of risking the player running out of memory.
- Release the cue and phrase indicators when a stems stream fails, instead of leaving them waiting for the rest of that track.
- Reduce background CPU use: an idle stems loader, diagnostic audio captures (now only when diagnostics are requested), repeated Grid probes on tracks without a usable grid, repeated cue/phrase indicator retries, and waveform drawing.
- Make installation safer against power loss: the installer now replaces the saved overlay in one step, so an interruption leaves the previous installation intact.
- Always start the stock player if the mods stop unexpectedly, even when the player's storage cannot record the fallback.
